title: Reproaching and Blaming
goal: Report a reproach with reprochar, and name a fault with culpar or acusar.
grammar: Reproaching and blaming: reprochar, echar en cara, culpar, acusar

items: I can report a reproach with reprochar or echar en cara + que + subjunctive.
I can name the fault with culpar or acusar a alguien de.
I can use the new words for blaming and complaining.
